title: Retained-run settlement: refused_claims does not survive a restart, and recovery_reason is last-writer-wins
outcome: A claim whose retained run was retired on claim_not_current_for_run keeps its disposition route across a restart: refused_claims persists, or is re-derived from retired_runs. A work's recovery_reason no longer loses a store-integrity alarm to a later transient failure, and no longer names a retired run while other runs remain retained.
acceptance: Retained-run settlement: refused_claims does not survive a restart, and recovery_reason is last-writer-wins is done
